svg.title: United Kingdom: England and Wales study map
svg.desc: Representative places for orientation. These dots are not legal wine-area boundaries. Named towns locate the surrounding study area; the country window may omit distant territory. 1: Kent; 2: Sussex; 3: Hampshire; 4: Essex; 5: Monmouthshire; 6: Cornwall; 7: London; 8: Birmingham; 9: Manchester; 10: Belfast; 11: Leeds; 12: Newcastle

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine

g.text: Natural Earth · GeoNames CC BY 4.0 · representative locations · no appellation boundaries
